## Purpose

This page summarizes the standalone technical scope of M9 - Document Summarization.

## Technical Scope

- Python runtime with requirements-based setup
- Endpoint mode via Villanova endpoint settings or OpenAI API key
- Input support for raw text and UTF-8 file ingestion
- Intended for prototyping and integration workflows
- Does not include extractive citation grounding or factuality verification

## Run Guidance

python -m source.summarization_component --input_file text_example.txt

## Expected Outcome

A reproducible execution path suitable for technical validation, demonstrations, and staged integration into platform workflows.
